about_the_game:
Galactic Plague 2000 is a shoot 'em up that blends classic arcade gameplay with modern roguelite elements. Experience the action your way with two distinct visual modes:

  • Retro Mode – A love letter to the old-school era, featuring filters and effects that recreate the iconic arcade aesthetics of the '80s.

  • Normal Mode – A crisp, filter-free presentation for those who prefer a more modern look.

A Cosmic Battle for Survival

In Story Mode, you take on the role of Jack, a young boy who stumbles upon a mysterious arcade machine in an abandoned game center—only to be pulled into an intergalactic war. To save the galaxy, he must pilot a powerful starfighter and recover the nine magic cubes stolen by the invading Martians.

Each playthrough is a high-stakes challenge where you'll upgrade your ship, unlock legendary weapons, and battle relentless enemies across nine unique worlds. Can you stop the plague before it's too late?

Key Features:

  • Story Mode – Conquer nine worlds, each with 14 action-packed stages and an epic boss fight at the end.

  • Arcade Mode (Extreme Survival) – Push your skills to the limit in the ultimate endurance challenge and compete for the top spot on the global leaderboards.

  • Upgrade System & Achievements – Power up your ship and master new abilities.

  • Over 20 enemy types & nine formidable bosses that will test your reflexes.

  • Customizable loadouts featuring nine distinct weapons and eight special abilities.

  • A dynamic sci-fi soundtrack blending 16-bit retro vibes with cyberpunk and cinematic influences—immersing you in an epic space adventure worthy of a classic anime.
